issues.body: The file still begins with `[OPUS-4.8]`. AGENTS.md explicitly says model-qualified source provenance markers are legacy and must migrate when touched, and the routed provenance rule requires model-agnostic SPARQ identity. This PR changes the workflow but leaves that legacy model identity embedded in the source, so the change is not complete under the repository's authoring rules.
issues.fix_hint: Replace the legacy `[OPUS-4.8]` source provenance marker with the model-agnostic `[SPARQ agent]` marker; do not add a model name or Co-Authored-By line.
issues.title: Touched source retains a legacy model-qualified provenance header

verdict.summary: The schedule change and its enforcement are technically sound: the live map is independently coverage-checked before collision analysis, absence fails closed, cadence is checked cyclically, forbidden-minute and collision behavior are tested with red fixtures, and the live seam binds the property to groom-leases.yml. However, the touched workflow retains a legacy model-qualified provenance marker, contrary to the repository's explicit touched-file migration rule and the model-agnostic identity requirement. Migrate that header before approval.
